answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the forge queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. The cedar index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1666 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ember. A 259 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
